# PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter

> PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter is designed for developers building and testing applications with familiar PostgreSQL tools and frameworks. It offers a fully managed, autoscaling database with pgvector-compatible vector search and selected PostgreSQL extensions.

## GET STARTED

- Why TiDB Cloud
  - [Introduction](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/tidb-cloud-intro.md): Learn about TiDB Cloud and its architecture.
  - [Features](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/features.md): Learn about feature support status for different TiDB Cloud plans.
  - [PostgreSQL Compatibility](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/postgresql-compatibility.md): Learn about the compatibility of PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter with PostgreSQL, including unsupported features and behavioral differences.
- Get Started
  - [Try Out TiDB Cloud Starter](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/pg-quickstart.md): Learn how to create and connect to a PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter instance.

- Manage TiDB Cloud Starter Instances

  - Monitor and Alert
    - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/monitor-tidb-cluster.md): Learn how to monitor your TiDB Cloud resource.
    - [Built-in Metrics](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/built-in-monitoring-pg.md): Learn about the built-in metrics available for PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter instances.
    - [Events](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/tidb-cloud-events.md): Learn how to view the events for TiDB Cloud resources using the Events page.
  - [Delete a TiDB Cloud Starter Instance](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/delete-tidb-cluster.md): Learn how to delete a TiDB Cloud Resource.
- [Migrate from PostgreSQL to TiDB Cloud Starter](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/import-with-psql.md): Learn how to migrate schema and data from PostgreSQL to a PostgreSQL-compatible TiDB Cloud Starter instance using `psql` and `\copy`.

    - [Identity Access Management](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/manage-user-access.md): Learn how to manage identity access in TiDB Cloud.

  - Network Access Control
    - [TLS Connections to TiDB Cloud](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/secure-connections-to-serverless-clusters.md): Introduce TLS connections in TiDB Cloud Starter and TiDB Cloud Essential.

    - [Console Audit Logging](https://docs.pingcap.com/tidbcloud/tidb-cloud-console-auditing.md): Learn about the audit logging feature for the TiDB Cloud console.
